[color=#cc99ff][b]installation (standart)[/b]:[/color] just take that .xnb file inside .zip archive and drop it into your 'Stardew Valley/Content' and 'Stardew Valley/Content/Maps' folders
[b][color=#cc99ff]installation (Content Patcher ver.):[/color][/b] drop the files from .zip archive into your 'Stardew Valley\Mods' folder. don't forget what you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]main Content Patcher mod files[/url] to use this!
